---
title: "Extensions"
format:
  emiljs:
    extensions:
      - shout
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrors: []
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # the list reaches emil.js unchanged, and the fence stays a fence
        - ['extensions:', '- shout', '\n``` shout\n']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        # the folder extension, loaded by Quarto on Deno: its fence is rendered,
        # its stylesheet is in its own layer, and its runtime half is on the page
        - ['<p class="ext-shout-line" data-ext-shout="loud">HELLO</p>', '@layer emiljs-ext.shout', '__EMILJS_EXTENSIONS__']
---

## A custom fence

```shout
hello
```
